function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the complete content of a file from the disk.

path.description: The path to the file to read.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or overwrite content to a file on disk. Creates the file and folders if they do not exist.

path.description: The path of the file to write.

content.description: The exact text content to write into the file.

function.name: file_glob_search
function.description: Search for files in a directory.

path.description: The base directory to search in.

function.name: get_datetime
function.description: Get the current date and time.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for information using a search query. CRITICAL: Use ONLY for keyword searching when you don't know the exact URL. DO NOT pass a URL here; if you already have a target URL, use 'web_fetch' instead.

query.description: The search query terms (e.g. 'cachyos arch linux'). MUST NOT be a URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch and extract the main content of a specific web page as clean Markdown. CRITICAL: Use ONLY when you have a specific, known URL to read. DO NOT pass search queries here; if you need to search, use 'web_search' instead. For advanced page interactions (clicks, forms) or screenshots, use 'web_browse' instead.

url.description: The target website URL to fetch. MUST be a valid absolute URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.

function.name: web_browse
function.description: Navigate and capture screenshot or execute simple actions in a dynamic web page. CRITICAL: Use ONLY when active interactions (clicks, typing, scrolling), DOM screenshots, or multi-step sessions are required. For simply reading a static page's content, 'web_fetch' is much faster and resource-friendly.

url.description: The target website URL to navigate to.

proxy.description: Optional proxy URL (e.g. 'socks5://127.0.0.1:9050'). Set to null or false to connect directly.

screenshot_path.description: Optional file path to capture and save a PNG screenshot.
